title: JobApplication
description: Structured details extracted from a job application message. A field is null when the text does not state it.

input_status.description: valid: a job application with no conflicts. ambiguous: a job application where some detail is conflicting or unclear. invalid: not a job application.

applicant_name.description: Full name of the person applying.

location.description: Where the applicant is based now.

position_applied.description: Job title the applicant is applying for.

years_of_experience.description: Total years of work experience, only if stated as a number.

skills.description: Skills the applicant says they have.

expected_salary.description: Expected salary, as written, including currency.

available_from.description: Date the applicant can start, as written.

portfolio_url.description: Portfolio, GitHub or personal site link.

ambiguity_notes.description: One short note per conflicting or unclear detail. Empty when there are none.
